entries.description: A prose web article, blog post, or journalistic piece.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Standalone web essays, tutorials, medium posts, news articles.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Academic papers with formal peer-review citations, raw repositories.

entries.description: Academic research paper, preprint, or formal technical report.
entries.inclusion_criteria: ArXiv preprints, conference proceedings, peer-reviewed journal articles, formal PDFs.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Informal blog posts or product announcements.

entries.description: Source code repository, library, or open-source software project.
entries.inclusion_criteria: GitHub, GitLab, or Git repos, code libraries, CLI tools, software packages.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Blog posts discussing software without linking to the primary repo.

entries.description: A post or microblog update on X (Twitter).
entries.inclusion_criteria: X/Twitter status updates, single tweets, or threads.

entries.description: A message sent via email, especially self-sent research notes.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Gmail self-sent messages, forwarded links with personal comments.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Direct instant messaging or chat transcripts.

entries.description: Directly entered human thought, observation, or unlinked note.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Raw text notes, fleeting thoughts, essay seeds entered via edward add --text.

entries.description: Structured or unstructured research report authored by an AI agent or analyst.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Agent research bundle outputs, deep-dive synthesized summaries.

entries.description: Commercial product, SaaS application, or consumer hardware.
entries.inclusion_criteria: Landing pages, product specs, commercial tools, pricing pages.

entries.description: An object whose primary form does not match standard registered forms.
entries.exclusion_criteria: Content clearly identifiable as article, paper, repo, x-post, or note.
